newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania bank privatisation plan to be set March.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania bank privatisation plan to be set March.

text.p: Lithuania's central bank said on Friday it would have a blue-print ready for the privatisation of two state-run banks by March.
Lithuania is committed to privatising part of the state's share of the sector under an agreement with the World Bank.
"The plans will be drawn up by the start of March to privatize two state-run banks," Lithuania central bank govenor Reinoldijus Sharkinas told reporters.
"They will be privatised through an open bidding process," he added.
Sharkinas declined to say which two of the country's three state banks would be put up for auction. Most analysts expect the two will be the troubled State-commercial bank and the Agriculture Bank.
